hints.tr: Başlangıç kodu metnin içinde arıyor: sorgu parametresindeki ad da, başka bir alanın alt adı da geçiyor.
hints.en: The starter code searches the text: the name in a query parameter and a subdomain of another domain both get through.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"images.example", "cdn.images.example"}


def fetch_allowed(url):
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
        return False
    if parts.hostname not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:
        return False
    return parts.port in (None, 80, 443)

for url in [
    "https://images.example/a.png",
    "ftp://images.example/a.png",
    "https://images.example.other.example/a",
    "https://IMAGES.example/a.png",
    "http://cdn.images.example:8080/a",
    "https://other.example/?u=images.example",
]:
    print(fetch_allowed(url))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"images.example", "cdn.images.example"}


def fetch_allowed(url):
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
        return False
    if parts.hostname not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:
        return False
    return parts.port in (None, 80, 443)

for url in [
    "https://images.example/a.png",
    "ftp://images.example/a.png",
    "https://images.example.other.example/a",
    "https://IMAGES.example/a.png",
    "http://cdn.images.example:8080/a",
    "https://other.example/?u=images.example",
]:
    print(fetch_allowed(url))
```
